product_overview: A public-facing T-shirt catalogue and brand journal with guest purchase requests, plus an admin dashboard for managing products, orders, customers, and store configuration. Customers browse current and historical designs, then submit manual order requests that are confirmed through WhatsApp rather than an online payment gateway.
core_goals: Help customers discover current and historical T-shirt designs
Let customers view product details and available variants
Allow guest users to submit purchase requests without creating an account
Give the owner a central place to review and manage orders
Maintain customer history through submitted orders instead of customer accounts
Preserve limited-drop and out-of-stock products as part of the brand archive
Support manual payment confirmation and stock reduction after payment is confirmed
Let admins manage products, inventory, master data, journal content, and store settings

features.name: Public Catalogue Browsing
features.description: Customers can browse the active product catalogue, search and filter designs, and open product detail pages to inspect variants and availability.
user_flows: Navigate to /catalogue -> Browse product grid -> Filter products by category or keywords -> Open a product detail page -> Review product images, description, price, availability, and size/color options
Navigate to /catalogue -> Search for a product -> View matching results in the product grid -> Open a product detail page -> Inspect available variants and stock availability
Navigate to /catalogue -> Select a product card -> See the product detail page -> Review the full design and variant information

features.name: Guest Purchase Order Submission
features.description: Customers can submit a manual purchase request as a guest by selecting a product variant, entering shipping details, and proceeding to WhatsApp confirmation.
user_flows: Navigate to /products/[slug] -> Review product details -> Select size, color, and quantity -> Proceed to the order form -> Enter full name, phone number, and shipping address -> Select payment destination bank and shipping provider -> Submit the order request -> See the order confirmation and WhatsApp next step

Navigate to /order -> Choose the intended product and variant -> Enter customer and shipping details -> Review the order summary -> Submit the purchase request -> See confirmation that the request was sent
Navigate to /products/[slug] -> Select an unavailable quantity or variant -> Attempt to submit the order request -> See validation feedback that the selection is not accepted

features.name: Public Archive Gallery
features.description: Customers can browse historical and out-of-stock designs as part of the brand archive.
user_flows: Navigate to /archive -> Browse historical collection gallery -> Open an archived design -> View its details and status as historical or out of stock
Navigate to /archive -> Scroll through past designs -> Compare old releases with current catalogue items -> Open a design to inspect its visuals and information

features.name: Brand Journal
features.description: Visitors can read editorial journal entries that support the brand story and announcements.
user_flows: Navigate to /journal -> Browse published articles -> Open an article -> Read the full journal entry
Navigate to /journal -> Review latest posts -> Open another article from the listing -> Continue reading related brand content

features.name: Brand Information Pages
features.description: Visitors can learn more about the brand and discover its positioning through static informational pages.
user_flows: Navigate to /about -> Read the brand story and background -> Return to the catalogue to continue browsing
Navigate to / -> Review the homepage hero, featured products, and latest journal entries -> Go to /catalogue to explore products

features.name: Admin Authentication
features.description: Admins can sign in to access protected management dashboards.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter admin email and password -> Submit the login form -> See the dashboard after successful authentication
Navigate to /login -> Enter an invalid email or password -> Submit the login form -> See authentication error feedback

features.name: Admin Dashboard Overview
features.description: Authenticated admins can view key store metrics and recent activity from a central dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Review sales metrics, order counts, and recent activity -> Use the overview to decide what to manage next

features.name: Order & Payment Processing Management
features.description: Admins can review incoming orders, inspect order details, confirm payment, and update fulfillment progress.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/orders -> Filter orders by status -> Open an order -> Review customer details, product selection, and transfer proof -> Confirm payment -> See the order status update and stock deduction take effect
Navigate to /dashboard/orders -> Open an order -> Add a shipping tracking number -> Mark the order as shipped -> See the updated fulfillment status
Navigate to /dashboard/orders -> Filter to pending orders -> Review each order request -> Reject or cancel an order when appropriate -> See the order move to the selected status

features.name: Product Catalogue & Inventory Management
features.description: Admins can create, edit, and maintain products, variants, images, and stock levels.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/products -> View the product list and stock levels -> Create a new product -> Upload images, enter description and price, configure variants and stock -> Save the product -> See it appear in the catalogue management list
Navigate to /dashboard/products -> Open an existing product -> Edit product details or variant inventory -> Save changes -> See the updated product information
Navigate to /dashboard/products -> Identify an out-of-stock design -> Archive the product -> Preserve it as a historical catalogue item

features.name: Master Data & Store Configuration Management
features.description: Admins can maintain categories, sizes, colors, bank accounts, shipping settings, branding, WhatsApp contact details, and user-related configuration.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/master -> Add, edit, or delete categories, sizes, and colors -> Save the master data changes -> Use the updated options for product setup
Navigate to /dashboard/master -> Configure bank accounts for payment receipt -> Save the payment settings -> Use them in the guest order flow
Navigate to /dashboard/settings -> Update store branding and WhatsApp contact information -> Save the settings -> See the updated contact and store configuration reflected in the app

features.name: Customer Directory & Order History
features.description: Admins can review customers and their order history aggregated from guest submissions.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/customers -> Open a customer profile -> Review contact details and previous orders -> Use the history to understand past purchases
Navigate to /dashboard/customers -> Search through the customer directory -> Open a matching customer record -> Inspect the customer's order timeline

features.name: Archive Management
features.description: Admins can maintain historical design highlights and out-of-stock archive entries.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/archives -> Review archived designs -> Update archive entries or their presentation -> Keep historical products available as brand records

features.name: Journal Content Management
features.description: Admins can create and manage journal posts for the brand.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/journal -> Create a new article -> Add content and cover image -> Save or publish the post -> See it in the journal listing
Navigate to /dashboard/journal -> Open an existing post -> Edit the content or metadata -> Save the changes -> Keep the article updated for public reading

features.name: Financial and Order Reports
features.description: Admins can review reporting views for financial and order performance.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/reports -> Review report charts and summaries -> Use the analytics to understand sales and order performance

features.name: Customer Testimonies Management
features.description: Admins can manage testimonials and reviews that support customer trust on the public site.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard/testimonies -> Review customer testimonies -> Add or update testimonial content -> Save the changes -> Keep the social proof section current

Admin dashboard overview with key metrics, sales statistics, and recent activity

Customer directory and customer order history aggregated from guest orders
